question:

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  AND ha.XCL_011 = 100;
